comment: Digests for vendored, generated assets that ship inside apps/obsidian/src. These are DIP-excluded and must never be hand-edited; tests/vendor-assets.test.ts fails if a tracked digest stops matching. A regenerated asset gets a new digest only after a human confirms the upstream source.

apps/obsidian/src/paper.cjs.role: Paper base class plus embedded Tabler icon assets; Obsidian loads the plugin as a single module, so the icon set cannot be fetched at runtime.

provenance.upstream: unknown — no Tabler version marker exists in the file and no generator script is checked into this repository
provenance.regeneration: none available locally; the 1.6 MB icon blob on line 4 is not rebuildable from anything in this checkout

contents.note: Line 4 holds 98.7 percent of the file (1,613,729 bytes); every other line is hand-written logic.
